notes: Vinten Vantage (model no. V4142-001) is a compact, camera/lens-agnostic robotic pan-tilt head, not an integrated camera — it carries no native video I/O of its own; the customer's own camcorder/lens supplies the actual video signal. Physical I/O is limited to 5 ports located in a single rear cluster, confirmed from Vinten's official "Vantage Brochure" (2017/2023, vinten.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/Vantage_Brochure.pdf) and the labeled connector-panel illustration in the official "Vantage User Guide" (vinten.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/Vantage-User-Guide.pdf): 24V DC power in, Genlock, Ethernet, a combined RS232/422 serial port labeled "CAMERA", and a LANC control port. No bandwidth/version grade is published for any port (e.g. no Ethernet speed stated), so grade is omitted throughout — none of this unit's connector types fall on a gradeable scale anyway except Ethernet, whose speed isn't disclosed. Connector shell identification for the DC power jack, BNC (Genlock) and RJ45 (Ethernet) is clear from the manual's 3D-rendered connector-panel close-up; the RS232/422 "CAMERA" port and the LANC jack are rendered as small proprietary-looking connectors in that same diagram and their exact physical shell could not be independently confirmed, so the closest available connector ids (rs232 w/ rs422 accepts, and trs-3.5) were used — flag these two as lower-confidence. The live manufacturer site (vinten.com) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches, so data was sourced from the manufacturer's own PDF documents via web.archive.org captures (brochure capture dated 2024-03-25, user guide capture dated 2024-07-18), not directly from the live page. Other specs found alongside I/O: payload 4.5 kg/10 lb, head weight 2.2 kg, pan 355°, tilt 90°, speed 0.02–60°/s, operating temp +5° to 40°C, base fixing flat (bowl adapter optional) — device is desktop/mount-type, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted.

ports.name: 24V DC
ports.note: Low-voltage 24V DC, 1.25A / 24W. Powered from supplied external AC/DC power supply, a 24V distribution unit, or battery.

ports.name: Genlock
ports.note: Reference sync input, enables VR/AR tracking capability.

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: Standard Ethernet connectivity for direct connection to network infrastructure and HD-VRC/µVRC control systems. No speed/version stated by manufacturer.

ports.name: Camera
ports.note: Labeled 'CAMERA' on the connector panel. RS232/422 serial port for control of a wide range of cameras and lenses.

ports.name: LANC
ports.note: Closest listed connector id; LANC is industry-standard on a 2.5mm sub-mini stereo jack (not 3.5mm), which is not in the allowed connector list. Controls LANC-compatible camera functions (autofocus, auto iris, menu, zoom, focus, iris).
